name: Torii
description:
Torii is a SaaS Management Platform that helps organizations discover, manage, and optimize the software they use. This connector lets you work with your Torii data directly in Claude — ask about applications, users, licenses, contracts, transactions, and access, and take action without leaving the conversation.

With the Torii connector you can:
• Explore your SaaS portfolio — search apps, see usage, owners, and spend
• Look up users and their application access across the organization
• Query and manage contracts, renewals, and licenses
• Review transactions and software spend
• Manage custom fields, create and run workflows, and handle access requests
• Get answers grounded in your real Torii data, with links back to the Torii app

Ideal for IT, finance, and procurement teams who want fast, conversational access to their SaaS management data and the ability to act on it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Torii to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Torii to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.toriihq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Torii MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Torii lists 64 MCP tools, including add_app, bulk_request_access_on_user_behalf, create_a_custom_integration_account, create_a_new_field, create_app, create_contract, create_workflow, delete_contract, delete_field, delete_workflow, download_file, and get_action_execution_logs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Torii?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Torii in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Torii requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Torii is developed by Torii. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
